verdict.rationale: The pack documents no dedicated sandbox or non-production environment. It shows only adjacent ways to test safely: gate overrides and targeting internal testers (docs-29, docs-24), target apps that scope configs within a project (docs-41), and offline AI evals on a fixed test set that run before any real users see changes (docs-45). These are workarounds rather than an isolated sandbox. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/dev/staging environment separate from production data, isolation of test events and metrics from production, agent/MCP access scoped to non-production, and hands-on corroboration.
